prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1309; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in Conroe, Texas, when the collision occurred. Driver 1 reported turning left and was struck by Driver 2, whose vehicle was proceeding straight. The impact landed on the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle, and the damage visible on both vehicles is consistent with a broadside collision of this type. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to me or reported by anyone at the scene. Driver 1 stated that a shoulder injury was sustained in the impact, and the nature of that injury fits the force and direction of the collision as observed. A passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle, and both the passenger's presence and Driver 1's presence were confirmed by statements from witnesses at the scene. Driver 2 gave an account of the collision that matches Driver 1's description. Several witnesses and photographs taken at the scene corroborate the sequence of events as reported. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
